name: warp-studio
description: Creator tools for Warp rulesets (a Lumiverse extension) and the warp-rulebook CLI/MCP server.

scripts.verify: bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && bun build ./src/backend.ts ./src/frontend.ts --outdir ./dist --target browser --format esm && bun run build:tools
scripts.build:tools: bun build ./src/tools/cli.ts --outfile ./dist/warp-rulebook.js --target node && bun run guide
